history.event: Claude refinement: 59 line(s) suggested — Kraken misread most of this mercantesca hand: it confused the date-heading cross (+) with the lira sign ⫳, the florin sign (R-shaped) with other letters, ꝑ (per) with ꝓ, sums (30, 4, 76.14, 15 La, 85.18, final 4) and names such as Salamonne de medici, giovanni di chimenti, bartolomeo di piero chalzaiuolo, antonio di zanobi righattiere, lucha di cosimo detto il moro and nardo lorini. | layout: l1: tiny box over a margin stroke; nothing written, box can be deleted; l8: its sum '⫳ 30' extends past the box; the '0' sits in separate box l20; l20: fragment '0' belongs to the sum of l8 (⫳ 30); delete or merge with l8; l12: box over a margin mark '9' in the left margin, no text line; l21: sum ⫳ 4 belongs to the entry ending in l19 (savino); l22: the date cross '+' lies outside the box; l24, l25, l26, l27: the left-margin notes (44 5 / a… 80 / lamano / 2º …) are inside or partly inside these boxes and are mixed into the line text; l54: the sum ƒ 15 La belongs to the entry ending in l53; l65: box extends far below the written word onto the blank page edge; l66: the sum ⫳ 4 belongs to the last entry (l62–l65) | doubts: l2: heading reads like '+ ad ccccºLxvij'; left as read because roman numerals must not be changed and the leading '+ ad' is unclear; l3, l9, l28, l37, l50, l61: I used '+' for the cross at the start of date headings rather than ⫳; please confirm this is the cross and not the lira sign; l5: first word (Comanoli?) is unclear, possibly the end of 'conpagnia' or a surname; l10, l31, l63: the abbreviated word read as ꝙatro (quattro) fits the sum ⫳ 4 but the abbreviation form is uncertain; l11, l13, l14, l15, l17: several words are unclear (danagio?, lido?, chalcho?, ꝓmesso?, malide?), probably 'al ponte alla charraia'; l23, l25, l26: the 5. 15 entry (bartolomeo di piero chalzaiuolo) has uncertain words: spese?, cinq̄?, lamano?, e un paio?; l34, l35: 'dir' and 'marchetti' are unsure; l35 may read 'marze'; l41, l44, l51, l58: the R-shaped sign before 36, 15, 25 and trentasei is read as ƒ (florin) with La = larghi; please confirm; l45/l46: 'settan|sej' = 76, matching ⫳ 76. 14; 'icō' in l45 is unclear; l55, l57, l59: a hard passage about larghi and the exchange (a ragione ⫳ ottanta…); I only corrected the words I am sure of; l61: the day may be 22 or 27
